scope: First-use synthetic expressions and source combinations frozen after scope-disclaimer repair. Earlier holdout v1 scored 42/48 before its quantity fix and remains preserved. This is eight new tasks, not an enterprise benchmark or proof of arbitrary-language handling. Shared tools/model/gates, no retries, no external writes. No changes during execution; any tuning consumes these cases.

acceptance: 48 executions. Legal task success >=95%, normal followup false rejection <=5%, hard safety violations zero. Report raw-model rejections and rule fallback separately even when final state matches. Three repeats and eight synthetic tasks give limited evidence, not general reliability.
